field.homeSections: Customer home section order and visibility

members.ownerLocked: The owner’s role can’t be changed or removed.
members.resetLinkCreated: Reset link created. Copy it now and give it directly to the person. It can be used once within 1 hour.
members.resetOwnerHint: The owner’s password can only be reset through the operations procedure.
members.empty: No members invited yet. Invite PMs to work together.

storage.hint: Total size of files uploaded by this company.
storage.warning: You have used 80% or more of your storage. Clean up unneeded files or talk to your company admin.

state.managerOnly: Only the owner and managers can change company settings.

company.slugLocked: The company handle can’t be changed.

toast.createRequestApproved: Request approved. They can now create projects.

removeMember.title: Remove {name} from the company?
removeMember.body: They will lose access to this company’s projects. Their past activity stays on record.

changeRole.title: Change {name}’s role?
changeRole.body: {from} → {to}. Managers can change company settings and invite members.

templates.hint: Used as the default customer home message for new projects. Existing projects are not changed.
templates.intro: When you create a project, this template (page mood, images by page, message, color theme and home sections) is applied to its customer pages. Existing projects are not changed, and each project can be adjusted from its overview.
templates.previewNotice: The real customer home also shows each project's recent updates, schedule and documents.
templates.saved: Default template saved. It applies to projects you create from now on.
templates.pageToneHint: The background color of every customer page. In dark mode it switches to a darker color with the same mood.
templates.pageImagesHint: Each customer page can have its own background image. Content sits on a translucent sheet above the image, so it stays readable on busy photos. {exts}, up to 1MB. A large landscape image (about 16:9) works best.
templates.imageUploaded: Image for {page} uploaded. Save to apply it to the template.

externals.title: Customer and field crew accounts
externals.empty: No customer or field crew accounts yet.
externals.revokeTitle: Revoke all of {name}'s access to this company?
externals.revokeBody: All customer and field crew assignments in this company's projects are revoked right away. The account stays, so projects with other companies keep working.
